stem.archstudio.repeat_count_error: Enter a whole number from 1 to 12 for new copies.
stem.archstudio.repeat_help: Each copy moves one more spacing step from the original. The original stays selected; all new copies are one undo step.
stem.archstudio.repeat_presets_help: Rows leave one empty cell between copies. Stacking uses the selected height with no gap. Adjust any spacing below.
stem.archstudio.repeat_legend: Solid outline: original. Dashed outlines: new copies. Crosses: occupied cells.
stem.archstudio.repeat_projection_note: Plan collapses height; front collapses depth. Crosses mark actual 3D conflicts.
stem.archstudio.repeat_summary: {copies} new copies · {blocks} added blocks · {cost} studio credits
stem.archstudio.repeat_extent: Layout: {width} wide × {depth} deep × {height} high, in grid units.
stem.archstudio.repeat_repeated: Added {count} blocks as repeated copies. The original region is still selected. Undo removes all copies.
stem.archstudio.repeat_already_added: Copies added. Change the spacing or select another region to add more.
